description: End the day island-style with our Signature Bonfire Experience. Gather around an exclusive firepit with seating for up to six, a dedicated bonfire attendant and everything you need to enjoy a relaxed night beneath the palms. Toast marshmallows, make s’mores and settle in for quality time together as the sun sets over the bay.
what_is_included:
- Set up and breakdown of a portable fire pit
- Seating for up to 6
- S'mores kit 
- Two bundles of firewood

Holiday weekends call for a little something extra—enhanced bonfire experiences with special seasonal touches. See pricing below.

highlights:
- Reserved fireside seating exclusively set up for your group
- Dedicated bonfire attendant to tend the fire and take care of the details
- Classic s’mores experience with all the essentials for roasting
- Bayfront setting on Mission Bay for a quintessential San Diego evening
- Beautiful sunset atmosphere followed by a cozy night beneath the palms
- Perfect for families, couples and groups looking to spend quality time together
- Effortless experience with the setup handled for you—just arrive, settle in and enjoy
- A signature Paradise Point memory that combines the resort’s island setting with one of Southern California’s favorite traditions
